title: Zelensky Says He Hopes Trump Will Help to End Russia-Ukraine War ‘Before Winter’
summary_full: The remarks by President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine came during a meeting with President Trump as an effort to restart talks with Russia has gone nowhere.
summary_public: The remarks by President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine came during a meeting with President Trump as an effort to restart talks with Russia has gone nowhere.
